name: Facilitation payment to expedite permit / inspection
description: Cash or hospitality offered to a public official to expedite a permit, inspection, customs clearance.

name: Kickback in supplier / customer relationship
description: Employee accepts kickback for awarding contract; or pays kickback to win one.

name: Agent / intermediary corruption
description: Third-party agent makes corrupt payment on behalf of the entity; entity remains liable under UKBA s.7.

name: Tender rigging / bid collusion
description: Collusion with competitors or buyer to rig the outcome of a public or private tender.

name: Excessive gifts / hospitality
description: Gifts or hospitality exchanged with public officials or counterparties beyond reasonable thresholds.
